events.title: Bay Street Poised To Open On Firm Note
events.description: Notably higher U.S. and Canadian futures and rising precious metals prices point to a firm start for the Canadian market on Monday. Tech stocks may climb higher, rebounding from recent losses.

events.title: CrowdStrike Posts Q3 Profit, Positive Outlook; Zscaler Stock Climbs On $43.9 Bln Takeover Deal
events.description: Cybersecurity tech firm CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. Monday announced its agreement to acquire cloud security platform Zscaler, Inc. in an all-stock transaction valued at about $43.9 billion. The news comes as CrowdStrike recorded a turnaround in its third quarter with increased revenues and raised fiscal 2027 view, while Zscaler generated wider first-quarter net loss and narrower pre-tax loss.

events.title: UK Private Sector Growth Slows
events.description: The UK private sector output growth eased in November amid a loss of momentum in the service economy, flash survey data from S&P Global showed Monday. The composite output index declined to 52.3 in November from October's eight-month high of 52.9. The score was expected to fall to 51.9. Nonetheless, the index remained above the neutral 50.0 value and pointed to a moderate pace of expansion.

events.title: Swiss Franc Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Swiss franc strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Monday.

events.title: Eurozone Private Sector Logs Moderate Growth
events.description: The euro area private sector registered a moderate growth in November, driven by faster growth in Germany, which countered a deepening downturn in France, flash survey results from S&P Global showed Monday. The flash composite output index remained unchanged at 51.7 in November. A score above 50.0 indicates expansion. A sharper increase in manufacturing output was cancelled out by slower growth

events.title: FTSE 100 Gains 0.55% On Mining Rally; Weak PMI Limits Upside
events.description: The FTSE 100 climbed 57.10 points to 10,403.44 Monday, buoyed by mining and banking gains as precious metal prices rebounded. Weak PMI data capped market gains.

events.title: Tech Sector Lifts French Stocks Despite Services Sector Contraction
events.description: French equities advanced Monday with the CAC 40 climbing 58.30 points to 7,986.05, driven by technology sector strength and lower oil prices. Services sector contraction limited gains as survey data signaled deepening private sector downturn.

events.title: German Stock Index Climbs On Tech Support, PMI Surge
events.description: Germany's DAX rose 0.75% Monday as AI stocks rebounded and oil prices fell. Flash survey data showed the private sector grew at its fastest pace since early 2022 in November, with the composite output index reaching 55.0.

events.title: Indian Shares Tumble Amid Global Selloff, Profit Taking
events.description: Indian shares fell sharply on Monday as a global sell-off in AI-related and semiconductor shares prompted traders to lock in gains after a strong run in recent weeks.

events.title: Gold Rebounds Amid Short Covering
events.description: Gold prices rebounded on Monday after suffering their worst weekly decline since the pandemic on hawkish Fed rhetoric and a rout in AI stocks.

events.title: Oil Extends Losses As Traders Weigh Supply Glut Risks
events.description: Oil prices traded lower on Monday, entering a fourth week of declines on expectations of rising global supply.

events.title: European Shares Modestly Higher As Tech Stocks Rebound
events.description: European stocks inched higher on Monday after posting their steepest weekly decline since late March 2025, reflecting waning enthusiasm for artificial intelligence-related bets.

events.title: Asian Shares Retreat As Tech Selloff Deepens
events.description: Asian stocks tumbled on Monday as a tech sell-off deepened on growing concerns over the sustainability of the AI boom and the prospect of faster Fed tightening.
